title: Pay the existing repair operation and its renewal limits
statement: ROOT read Hamilton–Sottos–White main Methods/Results/Conclusion: external pumping supplies reactive fluids to a prepared epoxy fracture; dynamic flow improves mixing. Load-frame support, manual excess-fluid removal, 48-hour cure at 30 C and sometimes lateral clamps are paid operations. Accumulated film impedes later flow. This is measured fracture recovery, not an autonomous actuator or unlimited regeneration; image equations, figures and supporting files were not reconstructed or followed.

requires: Actual missing material, retained load, mixing, transport, cure, temporary support, useful force-displacement-work and renewed access belong to the complete operation. The hydraulic example assumes a rectangular throat and prescribed cure-front growth; the pressure screen assumes an undeformed isotropic thick cylinder. Neither constitutive law is a measured actuator or resin model.

assumptions: Prepared epoxy fractures with pumping, support, manual cleanup, long cure or clamping are not autonomous soft actuators. Manually realigned tensile cuts and limited contact tests do not qualify a useful pressure body or repeated damaged-device life. External sealing, recovered shape or compensated force can coexist with missing material or depleted redundancy. All numerical laws below are introduced; no actual cure window, renewed conduit or restored useful-load life is established.
costs: Whole 14,647-byte ROOT note 6fee8fe4 is reused at its repair scope. The original note and its 7,576-byte Python 94c52adc/5,009-byte JSON 4bb074c0 are published once with the microdevice source package; this family links that common evidence rather than claiming independent corroboration. ROOT calculations are not executed by Capital. Actual primary/maker exposures retain their recorded limits. All holds persist; no new governing-source or artifact recovery, experiment or scientific audit.
contract.units: Source-reported finite chemical, transport, financial, mechanical and measurement quantities at their stated assumptions; no Capital scientific execution.
obstruction: Construct actual delivery, containment, mixing, cure and load transfer while preserving or restoring access after each repair. Qualify pressure, force through useful stroke, work, damage, consumed stock and return to readiness. Proposed discriminating experiments are not physical execution or spending authority.

review.scope: Whole supplied original available derivations at exact stated scope; reported numerical execution is not physical qualification, a supplier quotation, novelty, an integrated invention or a new independent Capital audit.
